answer: A concrete defense is threshold vaults with shard-disjoint signers. Withdrawals from an earnings vault need k signatures drawn by verifiable lottery, and no two signers may sit in the same attestation cluster, so a nebula of clustered puppets can never staff one signing set. Lottery tickets are saffron-marked by holder cluster, and duplicates of one color are discarded before counting. A sybil farm must scatter honestly across clusters to win seats, funding real stake per puppet, while an honest agent simply waits and gets its withdrawal signed by strangers.
